items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I was with Curtis Moseby, at the Apex... I sang a lot of things because I used to be a vocalist. I used to sing 'Sunny Side of the Street' and things like that in Curtis Moseby's band

ctx.x: That was what year, you joined Curtis Moseby's band?

I think it was about 1929. He also was the first guy to ever bring a jazz club to San Francisco, Curtis Moseby was. He bought a place at the corner. He leased a place at the corner of Grant and Bush, which is the exact edge of Chinatown in San Francisco. It was the old Chinese Gardens or something, one of those things, and he leased that place and opened the Apex Number Two in 1929, '30 era and I went up there to open that up the first time I ever left home with a traveling band. We opened the Apex Number Two in,…
